title: Native Chinese Reader: A Dataset Towards Native-Level Chinese Machine Reading Comprehension
reasoning: The paper focuses on linguistic and reasoning capabilities for machine reading comprehension. The dataset is derived from high school Chinese language exams, which may include literary or historical content, but there is no component designed to evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. A concluding remark on ethical issues pertains to the research process (data sourcing, participant consent) rather than the content of the benchmark itself.
